reports.name: Declaracao Modelo 3
reports.description: Portugal annual IRS Modelo 3 filing window for the 2025 income year.

workflows.name: Review IRS pre-filled data
workflows.description: Review household data, e-Fatura expenses, withholding, and pre-filled income before submitting Modelo 3.

workflows.name: Submit Declaracao Modelo 3
workflows.description: Submit the annual IRS return and annexes during the April-to-June filing window.

workflows.name: Settle annual IRS balance
workflows.description: Pay the annual IRS balance by the assessment deadline when the declaration results in tax due.

events.title: 2025 IRS Modelo 3 submission deadline
events.description: Modelo 3 for 2025 income is submitted from 1 April to 30 June 2026.

events.title: 2025 IRS balance payment deadline
events.description: Any annual IRS balance for the 2025 return is generally paid by 31 August 2026.

reports.name: IRS payments on account
reports.description: Portugal IRS payments on account for qualifying self-employed taxpayers in the 2026 calendar year.

workflows.name: Confirm payment-on-account requirement
workflows.description: Confirm whether the taxpayer is required to make IRS payments on account for category B activity.

workflows.name: Prepare IRS installment payment
workflows.description: Review the AT payment notice and available credits before settling each installment.

events.title: First 2026 IRS payment-on-account deadline
events.description: First IRS payment on account is due by 20 July 2026 where applicable.

events.title: Second 2026 IRS payment-on-account deadline
events.description: Second IRS payment on account is due by 21 September 2026 where applicable.

events.title: Third 2026 IRS payment-on-account deadline
events.description: Third IRS payment on account is due by 21 December 2026 where applicable.
